problem_statement.interpretation: The completed 57-file repair fixed the previously authorized denominator only. This later header audit found 14 additional missing-time entities across four formal capabilities outside that 237-projection target set; they are new failures and are not covered by the prior authorization.

allowed_changes_if_approved: Freeze a dry-run plan for exactly the 14 additional missing explicit-time entities bound by target manifest SHA-256 ab817674837bb6c47249464104b9de96b877b806c3e607fdbb5996fa7a5f34e0, then add only explicit per-row time_s under a declared endpoint rule while preserving row count, row order and all non-time physical bytes.

sat_agent_source_changes.reason_existing_backfill_is_separate: An exact before/after target inventory, file hashes and preservation plan must be submitted before mutating existing manifest bundles.

mandatory_preservation_rules: Keep the completed 57-file repair and all earlier failures immutable; do not expand its authorization retroactively.
Keep all 14 newly discovered missing-time entities in the new denominator; any repair failure remains a failure.
Do not add labels, truth, fault/effect identity, severity, onset, seed, split, target identity, case/path identity, simulator answers or outcome-derived proxies.
Do not use opaque provenance IDs, hashes, capability IDs, backend IDs or family IDs as learned inputs, gates, routers, feature-selection variables or outcome proxies.
Do not infer semantic quantity, port role or archetype solely from field names; every new AstroGraph mapping requires a manual contract review and tests.
Do not delete, skip, deduplicate out of a denominator, merge classes, expand UNKNOWN, lower thresholds or reuse exhausted validation seeds.
Do not materialize a split, create a seed, fit/calibrate a model, generate formal open classes, run technical validation, access hidden truth or start Stage S1/Stage B.

Post-write receipt proving changed=authorized, backups=authorized, non-time bytes preserved, row counts/order unchanged and all explicit time axes finite/strictly increasing.
Generator/schema tests proving every future provenance record validates and prohibited fields fail closed.
